title: At the fruit stall
text:
Seller: Good morning! Can I help you?
Budi: Good morning. How much are the oranges?
Seller: They are eight thousand rupiah for one kilo.
Budi: And the bananas?
Seller: Bananas are six thousand rupiah for one kilo.
Budi: I would like one kilo of oranges and one kilo of bananas, please. Can you put them in a bag?
Seller: Yes, of course. Here is a strong bag.
Seller: That is fourteen thousand rupiah.
Budi: Here you are. Thank you!
Seller: Thank you. Have a nice day! Come again soon!
